name: Boundless Plate
description: Spread a plate of Core qi so wide that it stands before the whole company at once.

name: Vast Rebuke
description: Return an assault upon the plate with a crushing weight that the Core feeds without strain.

name: Silencing Hand
description: Lay a silencing hand on a foe and still the foe's qi and voice together.

name: Profound Mending
description: Mend even a crushed limb or a torn organ of an ally under the held plate.

name: Edgeless Hush
description: Spread a hush with no edge that cancels each blow as it touches.

name: Imperial Return
description: Send the full force of a mighty strike back along its line with the Core's weight added.

name: Everlasting Mantle
description: Cast a mantle that does not wear and firms the guard of each ally beneath it.

name: Dawnlit Revival
description: Draw the Core's light over an ally whose breath and pulse have just stopped and start both again.

name: Crown of Wards
description: The school's crowning move: a crown of nested wards over the warded that holds to the last ward.

name: Nameless Aegis
description: The school's crowning move: an aegis that bears no name and hushes the qi of every foe it faces.

name: Unspoken Vow
description: The school's crowning move: a vow carried unspoken that makes the ward answer before the blow is made.

name: Calamity Refusal
description: Refuse a ruinous strike up to the destructive ceiling of its tier and cancel it outright.

name: Unwritten Harm
description: For one breath harm that reaches the warded is never recorded; no qi mechanic explains why the harm leaves no wound.

name: Refused Ending
description: The warded who has just died within the ward is not allowed to have ended; no qi mechanic explains the refusal.

name: Sheer Plate
description: Raise a plate of divine energy so smooth and sheer that no blow finds a hold on it.

name: Turned Heaven
description: Turn a strike on the plate so that it falls back on its source from above.

name: Pacifying Hush
description: Spread a pacifying hush across the field that draws the sting out of a foe's attack.

name: Soft Restoration
description: Restore an ally's body whole under a soft light that leaves no scar.

name: Sundered Silence
description: Break a mighty strike in a silence so deep that the strike makes no sound or mark.

name: Boundless Rebound
description: Return a mighty strike with a share of the user's divine weight added and no limit to its reach.

name: Perpetual Mantle
description: Cast a mantle that renews itself as it wears and firms every guard beneath it.

name: Hallowed Recall
description: Pour hallowed light into an ally whose heart has just stopped and call the heart back.

name: Aegis Eternal
description: The school's crowning move: an aegis that stands as long as the divine energy of the user endures.

name: Unbroken Vowing
description: The school's crowning move: a vow that cannot be broken from outside holds the ward whole.

name: Radiant Absolute
description: The school's crowning move: a radiant stillness that cancels any single force below the divine grade.

name: Cataclysm Refusal
description: Cancel a ruinous strike up to the destructive ceiling of the divine tier with a single refusal.

name: Last Sanction
description: The warded cannot be unmade by any single act for the length of the ward; no divine mechanic explains why.
